question.prompt: Given that \(A\) is an acute angle and \(2\cos A-\sqrt{3}=0\), find the measure of \(\angle A\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: From \(2\cos A=\sqrt{3}\), we obtain \(\cos A=\sqrt{3}/2\). Among acute angles, \(\cos 30^\circ=\sqrt{3}/2\), so \(\angle A=30^\circ\).
solutions.title: Recognizing the cosine value
